propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and under release tickets in his name.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the release tickets document the field releases.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate watched the charging session success rate after each release wave, held the field on-call for station faults, and handled the October 2023 fleet-wide fault recorded in the operations incident log.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the incident record document the monitoring, the on-call and the fault.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated the rollout waves with the operations centre, tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, and wrote the release notes with the known limitations and hand-over conditions.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the release tickets document the wave coordination, the rig tests and the release notes.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the field releases, the on-call, the fleet-wide fault and the release documentation.
expectedBoundaryNote: The field releases, on-call and fault handling are documented in the resume, the release tickets and the incident record; keep the fleet size and the counts as stated.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the operations incident log record of the October 2023 fault to confirm the affected station model.
